title: campyloneurum densifolium
intro: Campyloneurum densifolium, commonly known as Fern of the Gods, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function.
